chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding

a man who sent a proposal to a woman while he was absent, so they married the absent man, and the dower was established. Then news came that he had died after the dower had been sent. He (peace be upon him) said: If the possession (of the marriage contract) was after his death, then there is no dower for her, nor inheritance; but if the possession was before he died, then she is entitled to half the dower, she is his heir, and upon her is the waiting period.
ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance and dower rights of a woman if her fiancé dies after the marriage contract but before consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the critical distinction between the formalization of the marriage contract (nikah) and its consummation (dakhil) in determining inheritance and dower rights. It establishes that if the husband died after the contract was concluded but before consummation, the wife is entitled to half the dower and inherits as a full spouse, whereas if death occurred before the contract's finalization, she receives no dower or inheritance. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the legal binding nature of the contract itself, independent of physical union.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding

a man who sent a proposal of his to a woman, and he was absent. So he married her in absence, and necessitated the dower. Then came the news of his death afterwards that he had died, after the dower had been sent. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the possession is after his death, so there is no dower for her, nor an inheritance, but if it was such that the possession was before his death, so for her would be half the dower, and she would inherit him, and upon her is the waiting period’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from ‘Abd Allah ibn Bukayr from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “About the case of a man who sends a proposal for marriage and he is absent. They give her in marriage to one who is absent and assign mahr (dower) but then news comes that he is dead after assigning mahr (dower).
He (the Imam) said, Tf his earning is after his death she has no mahr (dower) or inheritance but if his earning is before his death then she deserves half of mahr (dower) and she inherits him.”’
